mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating accommodative monetary policy) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The mechanism is always active and does not require a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 255.0 (indicating elevated inflation) triggers a monetary policy tightening expectation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an overheating labor market, increasing the probability of monetary tightening and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 150,000 and UNRATE is below 3.5%, or Rank IC between interaction term and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes, strong housing starts (HOUST) indicate an overheating economy, increasing the likelihood of monetary tightening and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST exceeds 1200, or Rank IC between HOUST and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower unemployment rate (indicating a tight labor market) supports stronger corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The mechanism is always active and does not require a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: Rank IC between UNRATE and 5-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 105.0 (indicating a contraction in industrial activity) signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST) and robust retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1200 and RSAFS exceeds 500,000, or Rank IC between interaction term and returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdown regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of manufacturing slowdown periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC between INDPRO and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
